summary: Character entity is the field-meaning authority for CanonicalCharacter as CanonicalEntity character CharacterBody, with schema.ts owning types and this page owning what each field means and which formats produce it. How to read the field tables explains generated Field Type Producers Meaning cells from docs-fields. Composition lists eight always-present groups and optional presentation settings behavior plus bias worldName knowledgeRefs behaviorRefs variants. Identity covers name nickname and RoleCall casting attributes. Persona and voice holds personality scenario appearance Voice ImagePrompt and structured encodings. Prompts and injections covers system postHistory depth prefill additionalText and DepthInjection. Greetings and examples covers firstMessage alternate group greetings and mes_example. Media covers portrait assets Sprite visualKind faceLabel and MediaAsset. Presentation is casting-card color palette background spoilers. Settings and behavior first-classes dials and CharacterBehavior scripts never executed by converter. Attribution and discovery separates credit notes and ContentRating tags. Composition and variants defines body assembly links and CharacterVariant overlay. What rides escrow, not a field and See also close the map.

sections.title: How to read the field tables
sections.summary: Field tables are generated by scripts/docs-fields.ts and embedded verbatim; never hand-edit a cell, improve the schema doc comment and regenerate. Field is the canonical name with trailing question mark for optional. Type is the schema TypeScript type. Producers lists source formats from the doc comment or dash when untagged, including universal core fields whose provenance is prose. Meaning explains purpose; blank cells are self-evident primitives without schema annotation. Richer explanation lives only in surrounding prose never inside a cell.

sections.title: Composition
sections.summary: CharacterBody groups fields into eight always-present sub-objects identity persona prompts greetings examples media attribution and discovery, plus optional presentation settings and behavior sub-objects and five standalone fields bias worldName knowledgeRefs behaviorRefs and variants. Grouping mirrors how a card is authored not any one app storage layout. Full CharacterBody and CharacterVariant tables live in Composition and variants at the end. Sections walk each group with tables pasted from docs/generated/fields.character.md.

sections.title: Identity
sections.summary: Identity is who the character is: required name plus authored attributes. char macro resolves to name; nickname from CCv3 Risu Backyard overrides display without changing canonical name. tagline is a short one-liner. description is the main CCv2/v3 persona block. characterVersion is unannotated version text. RoleCall adds fullName title age as free text never int pronouns. Agnai culture drives default language and voice selection. Together these separate display casting metadata from the portable name slot.

sections.title: Persona and voice
sections.summary: Persona carries how the character behaves sounds and looks: personality scenario and Agnai appearance free-text, plus nested Voice for TTS selection not audio bytes, ImagePrompt for image-gen hints, and structured as a discriminated union that preserves attribute maps such as W++. Voice child covers provider voiceId rate pitch disabled and open extras. ImagePrompt child covers prompt prefix suffix negative template instructions emotionInstructions and labeled rows. Structured kinds text without attributes versus attributes wpp sbf boostyle requiring attributes so illegal states are unrepresentable. Other formats often fold appearance into description.

children.title: Voice
children.summary: Voice is the authored TTS selection and config, never model bytes which ride assets or escrow. provider is an open union including elevenlabs webspeechsynthesis novel agnaistic vits and more. Optional voiceId rate pitch and Agnai disabled keep config when voice is turned off. extras is an open Record for provider-specific knobs such as stability similarityBoost model seed and vits config.

children.title: ImagePrompt
children.summary: ImagePrompt is creator text that steers image generation for the character. Sampler and provider knobs are platform config and are not modeled. Fields include Risu full base prompt, prefix suffix negative, Agnai template, Risu instructions and emotionInstructions, and Risu sdData-style labeled rows of label value pairs.

sections.title: Prompts and injections
sections.summary: Prompts and injections hold instruction-layer text sent to the model. systemPrompt is the universal system slot. postHistoryInstructions is SillyTavern jailbreak post-history. depthInjections is an array of DepthInjection entries. Agnai prefill prepends to the assistant reply common with Claude. Risu additionalText is a simple plain append not a depth injection. The DepthInjection child defines text depth optional role origin for re-export home and enabled toggle where undefined means enabled.

children.title: DepthInjection
children.summary: DepthInjection places text at a fixed chat depth. Required text and depth; optional role system user or assistant. origin records which source mechanism produced the injection among depth_prompt rolecall_details and worldinfo so export re-emits to the original home. enabled is a creator toggle with undefined meaning enabled.

sections.title: Greetings and examples
sections.summary: Greetings and examples cover opening messages and example dialogue. firstMessage is the primary opening. alternateGreetings is an array of Greeting values. groupOnlyGreetings from CCv3 are group-chat-only and distinct from alternates. Greeting child is text plus optional title and format-local id for editing provenance that other writers drop, emitting only text and title. Examples child holds exampleMessages as the mes_example string slot.

children.title: Greeting
children.summary: One greeting with optional creator title. text is required content. title is optional display labeling. id is stable editing identity and format-local provenance, not user-facing portable content; other format writers emit only text and title.

children.title: Examples
children.summary: Examples holds optional exampleMessages as a single string corresponding to the wire mes_example dialogue block used for few-shot style character dialogue samples.

sections.title: Media
sections.summary: Media holds image references and the Agnai composite-avatar recipe; bytes live in the asset store or data URIs. portrait is the main MediaAsset. assets from RoleCall and Risu carry extra images and expression outfit pose packs. sprite is the Agnai composite recipe when visualType is sprite. visualKind is open avatar or sprite mode. faceLabel prefers an expression-pack label for the body or variant and binds the portrait stage without a second asset store. MediaAsset child defines role name label primary ref mime. Sprite child is parts map plus gender eye body hair colors as recipe not rendered pixels.

children.title: MediaAsset
children.summary: MediaAsset is one image reference and its purpose. role is portrait emotion outfit pose background or other. Optional name and RoleCall label for expression outfit pose variants. primary marks the main asset of its role. ref points into the entity asset store or a data URI. mime is optional content type.

children.title: Sprite
children.summary: Sprite is the Agnai builder-authored composite avatar recipe: named part selections in parts plus optional gender eyeColor bodyColor and hairColor. Rendered images are assets; this shape is only the authored recipe.

sections.title: Presentation
sections.summary: Presentation is the optional casting-card visual identity omitted by formats without the concept. signatureColor holds a single solid RC or Risu color; a two-to-three color blend rides gradientColors instead as one concept two storage shapes. Account-level accent is not modeled. palette is Swatch arrays; background is Background with optional video rate. fieldOrder is creator display order. spoilers is RC reveal config with fields boolean map preserved not collapsed. mediaLinks are RC external reference links. Swatch child is label name hex. Background child is ref overlayOpacity videoPlaybackRate.

children.title: Swatch
children.summary: Swatch is a named color in a card palette with optional label and name plus required hex value for the casting-card color system.

children.title: Background
children.summary: Background is a creator-curated backdrop reference with optional overlayOpacity and videoPlaybackRate when the asset is video, plus required ref into media storage.

sections.title: Settings and behavior
sections.summary: Settings and behavior hold authored inline dials and on-card behavior. Converter and editor NEVER execute any behavior payload: no eval require or DOM injection; execution only inside a later capability sandbox. Behavior re-emits only on its own format wire and is never blind-copied across formats. talkativeness is SillyTavern group turn weight 0 to 1. risu groups single-platform display toggles. responseSchema is Agnai structured-output config carried editable likely migrating to Preset later. CharacterBehavior child first-classes regexScripts as RegexScript twin, triggerScripts virtualScript background markup defaultVariables prebuiltAsset moduleToggles and privileged as warning and sandbox gate never execution. TriggerScript child is event conditions effects state machine rows.

children.title: CharacterBehavior
children.summary: CharacterBehavior carries card scripts and background markup as editable data. regexScripts are card-embedded find replace twins using RegexScript from the regex entity with one definition and no separate table here. triggerScripts virtualScript backgroundHTML backgroundCSS defaultVariables prebuiltAsset and moduleToggles are mostly Risu payloads. privileged records that the card requested low-level script API as a UI warning and sandbox gating input never an execution trigger.

children.title: TriggerScript
children.summary: TriggerScript is a trigger state-machine script carried verbatim-editable with optional label, required event such as Risu type output input start, and conditions and effects as unknown arrays of condition and effect rows.

sections.title: Attribution and discovery
sections.summary: Attribution and discovery cover credit provenance and how the card is found. Attribution fields include creator originalCreator source sourceUrl license creatorNotes as CCv2/v3 single-language notes creatorNotesMultilingual as CCv3 ISO map preferred over single-language and publicNote as RoleCall separate public from-the-creator note distinct from creatorNotes. createdAt and updatedAt are unix seconds. Discovery child holds free tags genre fandom ContentRating as all-ages mature or explicit kept out of free-text tags and contentWarnings as portable trigger warnings.

children.title: Discovery
children.summary: Discovery categorizes the card for browsing. tags genre and fandom are free strings. rating is explicit ContentRating all-ages mature or explicit and must stay out of free-text tags. contentWarnings are optional portable trigger warnings on the card.

sections.title: Composition and variants
sections.summary: Composition and variants is the top CharacterBody assembly of every group. worldName is SillyTavern intent to auto-load an external worldbook by NAME while knowledgeRefs links embedded lorebooks by canonical id. behaviorRefs links standalone regex script entities by id versus behavior which carries on-card CharacterBehavior content. bias is Risu NovelAI phrase weight pairs a different axis than lorebook loreBiasGroups. presentation settings optional. variants from RoleCall are CharacterVariant alternate versions. CharacterVariant child uses deep partial overrides via applyVariant with present keys counting as overrides including empty clear; mirrorBase true deep-overlays while false replaces whole defined sections.

children.title: CharacterVariant
children.summary: CharacterVariant is an alternate version of the character. overrides is DeepPartial of the body without nested variants; applyVariant in variant.ts deep-merges onto base so one field or a whole section may change. A field is overridden when its key is present including empty string clear; absent keys inherit. mirrorBase true or undefined is default deep overlay; false means each defined section replaces the base whole section while untouched sections inherit and name falls through when omitted. id is required; label optional.

sections.title: What rides escrow, not a field
sections.summary: Anything a single source keeps without a canonical field stays in escrow formatId raw and survives same-format round-trip. Cross-format conversion carries only the canonical body so private app data never copies into another app file. Escrow riders include RoleCall private ids, unmapped SillyTavern extension keys, app-local layout state, and source bytes such as PNG pixels in sourceMedia served as portrait. Authored on-card behavior does NOT ride escrow because it is first-classed in behavior as CharacterBehavior editable data re-emitted only on its own format wire and never executed by converter or editor.

sections.title: See also
sections.summary: Related authority pages close the character map. architecture.md owns the canonical model escrow hub-and-spoke and the adapter contract. entities/lorebook.md is the knowledgeRefs target superset. entities/regex.md owns behaviorRefs targets and the RegexScript shape of the card twin. concepts/character-book.md explains embedded character_book extract and re-embed. formats/README.md is the coverage matrix of every format and the fields it produces.
